Name: Mystic Blades
Author: 66rayyan99
Description:
# ⚔️ Mystic Blades HD

**Add 10 unique HD weapons to Stardew Valley — each with its own elemental power!**

Tired of the same old vanilla weapons? Mystic Blades HD introduces a collection of 10 hand-crafted swords (64x64 HD sprites) with unique combat effects. Whether you want to poison your enemies, steal their life force, or freeze them in place — there's a blade for every playstyle.

All weapons are available for purchase at **Marlon's shop** (Adventure Guild).

---

| Icon | Name | Damage | Effect | Price |
|------|------|--------|--------|-------|
| 🌊 | **The Pacific Ocean** | 15-20 | First strike pacifies enemy (5s) | 5,000g |
| 💜 | **Demon Blood** | 20-35 | Poisons enemies (20 dmg / 2s) | 7,500g |
| ❤️ | **Crimson Striker** | 22-35 | 10% chance to drop gold | 8,500g |
| ⚔️ | **The Catana** | 25-38 | Weakens enemy damage (2s) | 10,000g |

| 🩷 | **Lotus Crystal** | 30-40 | Heals 5% HP on kill (in mines) | 18,000g |
| 🌊 | **Abyssal Tide** | 30-44 | Freezes enemies (1.5s) | 20,000g |
| 🌙 | **Void Crescent** | 30-45 | Lifesteal 10% of damage dealt | 26,000g |
| ☀️ | **Solar Flare** | 32-48 | Burns enemies (15 dmg / 3s) | 32,000g |
| 💎 | **Space Crystal** | 35-50 | 15% chance to drop gems | 45,000g |

---

## ✨ Features

- **10 unique weapons** — each with a distinct visual design and combat effect
- **HD 64x64 sprites** — crisp, high-quality pixel art
- **Elemental effects:**
  - 🧪 Poison (damage over time)
  - 🔥 Burn (fire damage over time)
  - ❄️ Freeze (stops enemies in place)
  - 💚 Lifesteal (heal from damage dealt)
  - 💎 Gem drop (bonus loot)
  - 💰 Gold drop (extra money)
  - 🛡️ Pacify (enemy can't hurt you)
  - 🥄 Weaken (reduce enemy damage)
- **Balanced progression** — from cheap starter blades to end-game legendaries
- **All in one shop** — no need to hunt down rare drops
- **Multiplayer compatible** — works in co-op

---

## 📦 Installation

1. **Install SMAPI** (version 4.0.0 or higher) — [Download here](https://smapi.io)
2. **Download** this mod and extract the `.zip` file
3. **Copy** the `MysticBladesHD` folder into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder
4. **Launch** the game via SMAPI
5. **Visit Marlon's shop** to buy the weapons!

---

## 🔧 Requirements

- **Stardew Valley** 1.6 or higher
- **SMAPI** 4.0.0 or higher
- **Windows / Linux / macOS** (all platforms supported)

---

## 🛒 How to Get the Weapons

1. Complete the **Adventure Guild** quest line (kill 10 slimes)
2. Enter the **Adventure Guild** (west of the mines)
3. Talk to **Marlon**
4. All 10 weapons will appear in his shop!

> 💡 **Tip:** You need to reach the Adventure Guild first. If you haven't unlocked it yet, kill 10 slimes in the mines.

---

## ❓ FAQ

**Q: Where can I find the weapons?**
A: All weapons are sold by Marlon in the Adventure Guild.

**Q: Do the weapons work in multiplayer?**
A: Yes! They work in co-op and split-screen modes.

**Q: Are these weapons compatible with SVE / Ridgeside Village?**
A: Yes, but they may overlap with custom weapons from those mods. No conflicts expected.

**Q: Can I change the prices?**
A: Not in this version, but a config file may be added in a future update.

**Q: Are the effects balanced?**
A: Yes, each effect has a cooldown and damage values are balanced for mid-to-late game.

**Q: Will this mod work on mobile?**
A: Not officially supported, but should work if you can install SMAPI on mobile.

**Q: Can I use these weapons in my own mod?**
A: Please don't redistribute. Feel free to link to this page instead.
